title: Shipped template asset
description: JSON shape of one shipped template. required on each field is a suggested default only — any user who can edit the template may move a field between REQUIRED, RECOMMENDED and OPTIONAL (§13.2). The asset never locks requiredness.

name.description: Localisation key, not an English string (FE-L10N-01).

title.description: Catalogue templates only: the display name, catalogue data rather than UI text (FE-L10N-07).

code.description: Catalogue templates only: the catalogue code, for example UNI-001.

pack.description: Catalogue templates only: the record type whose pack group it inherits.

rollout.description: Catalogue templates only: suggested tier (foundation, expansion, specialist).

derives_from.description: Parent template_key when this asset extends another (§11.1).

field_key.description: Stable snake_case key. Never renamed once shipped.

label.description: Localisation key, not an English string (FE-L10N-01).

type.description: A FieldType from the registry of task 089. An unknown name is a violation (FE-CONS-07).

required.description: Suggested default only. The user can change REQUIRED, RECOMMENDED or OPTIONAL on a copy of this template (§13.2). The schema carries no locked requiredness.

input_mode.description: Who may fill the field (§12.2). Defaults to the group's mode, else any.

refine.description: Keep an AI-refined companion value beside the raw one (§32).

stickable.description: May be pinned as context and carried to the next record (§20).
